reviews.text:
A wonderful encounter with a truly passionate and honest person!

Good, clever, and practical advice.

A shop that doesn't look like much from the outside but is actually quite spacious inside, with lots of animals and plants.
Wonderful place, the owner is kind and generous

Fantastic pet shop, tiny but full of treasures, and the owner is a walking encyclopedia of knowledge and a source of invaluable advice, taking excellent care of both the animals and his customers. Thank you, Jean-Marc!
Excellent service and great advice for aquariums! Thank you, Jean-Marc!

No hesitation **** GO FOR IT **** A customer for 7 years, I receive great advice from the very friendly owner of this little shop. Beautiful fish that live a long time (you have to come regularly because the selection of fish changes depending on arrivals and births).
I bought a tortoise there. I received a very warm welcome and excellent advice; the manager and his staff are super friendly and really make you want to come back. I highly recommend it.
A very wide selection of fish species and a gentleman who is very passionate about his work, a very good salesman and very kind. You can visit him without hesitation.
Excellent product at a good price and a very warm welcome to customers. Very pleasant impression after my visit to this club.
Magnificent species. Advice from a passionate expert; only sells what is suitable for the client's aquarium. Top-notch!
For enthusiasts, this is the best place; the gentleman is very kind and pleasant.
My grandma has been taking her Yorkshire terrier, Jade, there recently and she's very, very happy with it. They do a great job and are very kind.
Excellent advice, friendly staff. Thank you for the welcome.
Super friendly owner, lots of choices!

Top-notch service! My dog ​​came out perfectly clean, well-groomed, and most importantly, relaxed. The team is very professional, gentle with the animals, and attentive to requests. You can tell they truly love animals. I highly recommend them! Thank you for your excellent work, see you very soon. 🐶✨ …

If you want truly excellent advice, Exo-Club is the place to find it. The owner is passionate and engaging, a bit of a chatterbox, but to our great delight, he's full of great tips, and the water turtle is doing wonderfully.
Thanks to Marco for his help, the best of the best! I highly recommend him, and most importantly, he'll be honest with you, unlike at Botanic.
